question: Can failures observed at the first CSS gate be repaired upstream by line-owned dimension axes, independent scale consensus, two-axis mass closure, and topology-paired roof datums, then transfer to a genuinely external HABS holdout while CSS remains read-only?

causal_repairs.dimension_axis: Prefer a nearby owned cardinal dimension line; retain token-shape axis only as held fallback.
causal_repairs.scale_owner: Derive each scale anchor independently from a complete notation or a strict dimension and its owned line span; promotion requires a compatible multi-origin consensus.
causal_repairs.mass_closure: Select one exterior extent per plan axis from closed chains or strict exterior dimensions and require a closed linework loop before primary-mass selection.
causal_repairs.roof_datums: Create ridge/eave datums only as a paired topology relation from opposed roof slopes in one elevation or section; numeric values require an independently calibrated view.
causal_repairs.css: Receive sealed evidence and metric graphs, compute residuals, and perform zero discovery or geometry correction.

authority.ocr_tokens: observed text proposals; numeric only after strict parsing or explicitly reported topology corroboration
authority.cv_lines: geometric support and dimension-line ownership candidates; never standalone semantic or scale authority
authority.evidence_graph: owns views, dimension-line bindings, chains, scale consensus, mass closure, and paired datums before CSS
authority.metric_graph: authoritative normalized primary envelope only after upstream promotion gates pass
authority.css: read-only projection and residual instrument; cannot discover or correct geometry

non_goals: Using fresh holdout evidence during development
Valheim prefab routing or Creator OS placement
Changing OCR or corpus promotion tolerances
